definitions.prologue: resident-batch begin until both waves reach the first MFMA of K block 1; includes startup and K block 0
definitions.mainloop: both resident waves are within K blocks 1..K_blocks-2
definitions.epilogue: first resident wave reaches final K block until both waves end; includes final K block, DQ drain, conversion and stores
definitions.mfma_efficiency: union of 16-cycle MFMA windows, starting at successful issue (attempt+stall), divided by phase cycles

scope: sampled physical SIMD union, not whole-GPU utilization or ordinary kernel latency
